import { HandleNotFound } from "../blueprint/things/handle/errors.ts";
import resolve from "../blueprint/things/handle/verbs/resolve.ts";
import { ProfileNotFound } from "../blueprint/things/profile/errors.ts";

const titles = (page: { links: ReadonlyArray<{ title: string }> }) => page.links.map((l) => l.title);

export default Blueprint.journey("anyone reads a public page", {
  // The visitor has no account and no token. Bob is signed in and owns nothing on this page.
  cast: { visitor: Blueprint.anyone, bob: Blueprint.signedIn },
  starts: "page-with-links",
  steps: (s) => [
    s.step(
      "a visitor resolves the name to a handle",
      s.visitor.run(resolve, { name: "linkpage" }),
      expect((a) => a.handle).toMatch(/^hdl_[0-9a-z]+$/),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ present: ["handle.resolve", "handle.resolve.load"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "a visitor reads the page: the name and every link, in order",
      s.visitor.run(get, { handle: "linkpage" }),
      expect((a) => a.handle).toBe("linkpage"),
      expect(titles).toEqual(["GitHub", "Blog", "Talks"]),
      expect((a) => a.links.map((l: { url: string }) => l.url)).toEqual([
        "https://github.com/aaron",
        "https://aaron.example.com/blog",
        "https://aaron.example.com/talks",
      ]),
      expect((a) => a.links.map((l: { id: string }) => /^lnk_[0-9a-z]+$/.test(l.id))).toEqual([true, true, true]),
      expect((a) => a.links[2].id).toBe(s.world.lastLink),
      expect((a) => Object.keys(a.links[0]).sort()).toEqual(["id", "title", "url"]),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ present: ["profile.get", "profile.get.load"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "a signed-in person who is not the owner reads the same page",
      s.bob.run(get, { handle: "linkpage" }),
      expect((a) => a.handle).toBe("linkpage"),
      expect(titles).toEqual(["GitHub", "Blog", "Talks"]),
      noEvents(),
    ),
    s.step(
      "a name nobody claimed has no page",
      s.visitor.run(get, { handle: "nosuchpage" }),
      refuses(ProfileNotFound),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ present: ["profile.get", "profile.get.load"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "a name nobody claimed does not resolve",
      s.visitor.run(resolve, { name: "nosuchpage" }),
      refuses(HandleNotFound),
      noEvents(),
    ),
  ],
});

/** A payload its schema refuses: the message names where and why, never the value. The call never left the client. */
export class InvalidPayload extends Data.TaggedError("InvalidPayload")<{ readonly message: string }> {}

/** What a call may be given: the key that makes its retries one request. Never a credential. */
export interface CallOptions {
  /** The key the server keeps the answer under. Made when the call starts when not given, and kept across its retries. */
  readonly requestKey?: string | undefined;
}

const RequestKey = Context.Reference<string | undefined>("linkup/RequestKey", { defaultValue: () => undefined });

/** Where a payload is refused and why, never what it held: a value can be a password, and this message can reach a span. */
const said = (issue: { readonly _tag: string; readonly path?: ReadonlyArray<unknown>; readonly issue?: unknown; readonly issues?: ReadonlyArray<unknown> }, path: ReadonlyArray<unknown> = []): ReadonlyArray<string> => {
  const where = path.length === 0 ? "the payload" : path.map(String).join(".");
  const inner = (next: unknown, more: ReadonlyArray<unknown> = []) => said(next as Parameters<typeof said>[0], [...path, ...more]);
  switch (issue._tag) {
    case "Pointer": return inner(issue.issue, issue.path);
    case "Encoding": return inner(issue.issue);
    case "Composite": case "AnyOf": case "OneOf": return (issue.issues ?? []).flatMap((next) => inner(next));
    case "MissingKey": return [`${where} is missing`];
    case "UnexpectedKey": return [`${where} is not expected`];
    case "InvalidType": return [`${where} is not the right kind of value`];
    case "Filter": return [`${where} does not satisfy its check`];
    default: return [`${where} is refused`];
  }
};

const isTransport = (error: unknown) => HttpClientError.isHttpClientError(error) && error.reason._tag === "TransportError";

/**
 * One call. Its payload is encoded first: one the schema refuses is `InvalidPayload`, and nothing is sent. A request key is made
 * when the call starts (or the caller's is used) and sent as `idempotency-key` on every try. An operation the server keeps an
 * answer for is tried again when the connection was cut before the answer came, with the same key, so it commits once.
 * A response the server could not answer is a defect (a die), never a typed failure.
 * A call wrapped in your own `Effect.retry` makes a new key on each try unless you pass `requestKey`.
 * The retry waits on Effect's own clock: `Timers` is the server runtime's, and this client runs in the caller's process.
 */
export const call = <A, E, R>(
  declaration: { readonly payloadSchema: Schema.Codec<any, any> },
  payload: unknown,
  options: CallOptions | undefined,
  retry: boolean,
  send: Effect.Effect<A, E, R>,
): Effect.Effect<A, E | InvalidPayload, R> =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    yield* Schema.encodeUnknownEffect(declaration.payloadSchema)(payload).pipe(Effect.mapError((cause) => new InvalidPayload({ message: said((cause as { readonly issue: Parameters<typeof said>[0] }).issue).join("; ") })));
    const key = options?.requestKey ?? (yield* Effect.flatMap(SecureRandom.SecureRandom, (random) => random.uuidV4()));
    const tries = retry ? Effect.retry(send, { schedule: Schedule.exponential("50 millis"), times: 3, while: isTransport }) : send;
    return yield* tries.pipe(
      Effect.catchIf((error) => HttpClientError.isHttpClientError(error) && !isTransport(error), (error) => Effect.die(error)),
      Effect.provideService(RequestKey, key),
    );
  }).pipe(Effect.provide(SecureRandom.layerWebCrypto));

const connect = (url: string, credential: Credential | undefined) =>
  Layer.effect(LinkUp, HttpApiClient.make(Api, {
    transformClient: HttpClient.mapRequestEffect((request) =>
      Effect.map(Effect.service(RequestKey), (key) => {
        const at = HttpClientRequest.prependUrl(request, url);
        const signed = credential === undefined ? at : HttpClientRequest.bearerToken(at, credential.token);
        return key === undefined ? signed : HttpClientRequest.setHeader(signed, "idempotency-key", key);
      })),
  })).pipe(Layer.provide(FetchHttpClient.layer));

/** A client for the server at `url`, as `credential` when there is one. */
export interface Options { readonly url: string; readonly credential?: Credential | undefined }

/** `layer({ url, credential })`, or `layer(url, token)`: the same client, the token being a session's. */
export const layer = (options: string | Options, token?: string) =>
  typeof options === "string" ? connect(options, token === undefined || token === "" ? undefined : Credential.session(token)) : connect(options.url, options.credential);

# link.add

Append a link to your own public page. You need a claimed name first.

**Who may call:** anyone signed in.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| title | link.title | What the link shows on the page, up to 120 characters. |
| url | link.url | Where the link goes: a web address starting with http:// or https://, up to 2048 characters. |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| link | link.id | The link's own id. |

## Move

`add`: from nothing (it creates) to listed, emitting LinkAdded.

## Steps

- `link.add.load` (database)
- `link.add.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| LinkNeedsHandle | 30 | LN-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't anyone signed in; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### a stranger cannot edit a page

Starts from the world `page-to-guard`.

- **bob has no page, so he has nowhere to add a link.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends title `Spam`, url `https://bob.example.com`, and is refused with LinkNeedsHandle, LN-001.

### add, order and remove a link

Starts from the world `page-to-edit`.

- **aaron adds a fourth link.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `Newsletter`, url `https://aaron.example.com/news`, and gets back an answer matching `^lnk_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### claim a handle

Starts from an empty world.

- **aaron cannot add a link before he has a page.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `GitHub`, url `https://github.com/aaron`, and is refused with LinkNeedsHandle, LN-001.

### release a handle

Starts from the world `claimed-to-release`.

- **aaron puts a link on his page before he lets the name go.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `Old link`, url `https://aaron.example.com/old`, and gets back an answer matching `^lnk_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **aaron has no page to add a link to any more.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `Too late`, url `https://aaron.example.com/late`, and is refused with LinkNeedsHandle, LN-001.
- **aaron can add a link again, to his new page.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `New link`, url `https://aaron.example.com/new`, and gets back an answer matching `^lnk_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### a person claims a page and shares it

Starts from an empty world.

- **aaron adds his GitHub.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `GitHub`, url `https://github.com/aaron`, and is answered.
- **aaron adds his blog.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `Blog`, url `https://aaron.example.com/blog`, and is answered.
- **aaron adds his talks.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends title `Talks`, url `https://aaron.example.com/talks`, and is answered.

## How to call

```sh
linkup link add --title <title> --url <url>
```

HTTP: `POST /link/add` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.link.add(payload)`.

### claim a handle

Starts from an empty world.

- **an unclaimed name has no public page.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends handle `firstpage`, and is refused with ProfileNotFound, PR-001.
- **the claim made a public page, with no links yet.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends handle `firstpage`, and gets back { handle: `firstpage`, links: [] }.

### release a handle

Starts from the world `claimed-to-release`.

- **the released name has no public page.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends handle `releasepage`, and is refused with ProfileNotFound, PR-001.
- **the new page has none of the old owner's links.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends handle `releasepage`, and gets back { handle: `releasepage`, links: [] }.
- **his new page has only the new link, and the old name's page is still bob's and empty.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends handle `aaronspage`, and gets back [`New link`].

### a person claims a page and shares it

Starts from an empty world.

- **anyone sees his public page at @aaron: three links in the order he added them.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends handle `aaron`, and gets back `aaron` and gets back [[`GitHub`, `https://github.com/aaron`], [`Blog`, `https://aaron.example.com/blog`], [`Talks`, `https://aaron.example.com/talks`]].

## How to call

```sh
linkup profile get --handle <handle>
```

HTTP: `POST /profile/get` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.profile.get(payload)`.

# link

A title and web address on a public page.

| field | value | description |

States: listed, removed. A move from the wrong state is refused LinkNotListed (exit 31).

|---|---|---|---|

# link.order

Move a link to a zero-based position. A position past the end puts it last.

**Who may call:** the linkOwner of the link.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| link | link.id | The link's own id. |
| position | LinkPosition | Its place in the page's list of links: 0 is first. |

## Answer

(none)

## Steps

- `link.order.load` (database)
- `link.order.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| LinkAlreadyRemoved | 32 | LN-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the linkOwner of the link; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### a stranger cannot edit a page

Starts from the world `page-to-guard`.

- **bob cannot move aaron's link, and the handler never runs.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends link the world's lastLink, position `0`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.

### add, order and remove a link

Starts from the world `page-to-edit`.

- **aaron moves the newsletter to the top.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends link the last call's links 3 id, position `0`, and is answered.
- **a position past the end puts a link last.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends link the last call's links 1 id, position `99`, and is answered.
- **he cannot move a removed link.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends link the world's lastLink, position `0`, and is refused with LinkAlreadyRemoved, LN-002.

## How to call

```sh
linkup link order --link <link> --position <position>
```

HTTP: `POST /link/order` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.link.order(payload)`.

# link.remove

Remove a link from a public page.

**Who may call:** the linkOwner of the link.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| link | link.id | The link's own id. |

## Answer

(none)

## Move

`remove`: from listed to removed, emitting LinkRemoved.

## Steps

- `link.remove.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| LinkNotListed | 31 | LN-900 | the link is in a state remove can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the linkOwner of the link; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### a stranger cannot edit a page

Starts from the world `page-to-guard`.

- **bob cannot remove aaron's link.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends link the world's lastLink, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **someone who is not signed in cannot remove it either.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends link the world's lastLink, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.

### add, order and remove a link

Starts from the world `page-to-edit`.

- **aaron removes the talks link.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends link the world's lastLink, and is answered.
- **he cannot remove it twice.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends link the world's lastLink, and is refused with LinkNotListed, LN-900, carrying state `removed`.

## How to call

```sh
linkup link remove --link <link>
```

// Journey-author file. The builder of handle.release never edits it (AGENTS.md, "Journeys and checks come first").
import { Blueprint, emits, expect, noEvents, refuses, spans } from "orthograph";
import { HandleNotFound } from "../blueprint/things/handle/errors.ts";
import { HandleClaimed, HandleReleased } from "../blueprint/things/handle/events.ts";
import { machine } from "../blueprint/things/handle/machine.ts";
import claim from "../blueprint/things/handle/verbs/claim.ts";
import release from "../blueprint/things/handle/verbs/release.ts";
import resolve from "../blueprint/things/handle/verbs/resolve.ts";
import { LinkNeedsHandle } from "../blueprint/things/link/errors.ts";
import { LinkAdded } from "../blueprint/things/link/events.ts";
import add from "../blueprint/things/link/verbs/add.ts";
import { ProfileNotFound } from "../blueprint/things/profile/errors.ts";
import get from "../blueprint/things/profile/verbs/get.ts";

export default Blueprint.journey("release a handle", {
  cast: { aaron: Blueprint.signedIn, bob: Blueprint.signedIn, visitor: Blueprint.anyone },
  starts: "claimed-to-release",
  steps: (s) => [
    s.step(
      "aaron puts a link on his page before he lets the name go",
      s.aaron.run(add, { title: "Old link", url: "https://aaron.example.com/old" }),
      expect((a) => a.link).toMatch(/^lnk_[0-9a-z]+$/),
    ),
    s.step(
      "bob cannot release aaron's name",
      s.bob.run(release, { handle: s.world.handle }),
      refuses(Blueprint.NotAllowed),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ absent: ["handle.release"] }),
      machine.isIn(s.world.handle, "claimed"),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron releases his name",
      s.aaron.run(release, { handle: s.world.handle }),
      emits(HandleReleased, { handle: s.world.handle, name: "releasepage" }),
      machine.isIn(s.world.handle, "released"),
      spans({ present: ["handle.release", "handle.release.record", "handle.release.commit"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "he cannot release it twice",
      s.aaron.run(release, { handle: s.world.handle }),
      refuses(machine.notFrom, { state: "released" }),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ absent: ["handle.release.record"] }),
      machine.isIn(s.world.handle, "released"),
    ),
    s.step(
      "the released name no longer resolves",
      s.visitor.run(resolve, { name: "releasepage" }),
      refuses(HandleNotFound),
      noEvents(),
    ),
    s.step(
      "the released name has no public page",
      s.visitor.run(get, { handle: "releasepage" }),
      refuses(ProfileNotFound),
      noEvents(),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron has no page to add a link to any more",
      s.aaron.run(add, { title: "Too late", url: "https://aaron.example.com/late" }),
      refuses(LinkNeedsHandle),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ absent: ["link.add.record"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "someone else claims the released name",
      s.bob.run(claim, { name: "releasepage" }),
      emits(HandleClaimed, { handle: s.last.handle, name: "releasepage" }),
      machine.isIn(s.last.handle, "claimed"),
      machine.isIn(s.world.handle, "released"),
    ),
    s.step(
      "the new page has none of the old owner's links",
      s.visitor.run(get, { handle: "releasepage" }),
      expect((a) => a).toEqual({ handle: "releasepage", links: [] }),
      noEvents(),
    ),
    s.step(
      "the old handle is not bob's: he cannot release it, and it stays released",
      s.bob.run(release, { handle: s.world.handle }),
      refuses(Blueprint.NotAllowed),
      noEvents(),
      machine.isIn(s.world.handle, "released"),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron can claim again: a released handle does not count as one he holds",
      s.aaron.run(claim, { name: "aaronspage" }),
      emits(HandleClaimed, { handle: s.last.handle, name: "aaronspage" }),
      machine.isIn(s.last.handle, "claimed"),
      spans({ present: ["handle.claim.record", "handle.claim.commit"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron can add a link again, to his new page",
      s.aaron.run(add, { title: "New link", url: "https://aaron.example.com/new" }),
      expect((a) => a.link).toMatch(/^lnk_[0-9a-z]+$/),
      emits(LinkAdded, { link: s.last.link }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "his new page has only the new link, and the old name's page is still bob's and empty",
      s.visitor.run(get, { handle: "aaronspage" }),
      expect((a) => a.links.map((l: { title: string }) => l.title)).toEqual(["New link"]),
      noEvents(),
    ),
  ],
});

import { NotEnoughFunds, AlreadyMember } from "../blueprint/things/membership/errors.ts";
import { MembershipJoined } from "../blueprint/things/membership/events.ts";
import { machine } from "../blueprint/things/membership/machine.ts";
import join from "../blueprint/things/membership/verbs/join.ts";

  cast: { aaron: Blueprint.signedIn, bob: Blueprint.signedIn, carol: Blueprint.signedIn },

    s.step(
      "carol cannot afford it, and nothing moves",
      s.carol.run(join, { page: s.world.handle }),
      refuses(NotEnoughFunds),
      noEvents(),
      pays.nothing(),
    ),
    s.step(
      "bob joins and the first month goes straight to aaron",
      s.bob.run(join, { page: s.world.handle }),
      emits(MembershipJoined, { membership: s.last.membership, price: "5.00" }),
      pays({ from: s.bob.account, to: s.aaron.account, amount: "5.00" }),
      machine.isIn(s.last.membership, "active"),
    ),
    s.step(
      "nobody but aaron holds the money",
      expect(() => s.world.balances()).toEqual({ aaron: "5.00", bob: "15.00", carol: "2.00" }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "bob cannot join twice",
      s.bob.run(join, { page: s.world.handle }),
      refuses(AlreadyMember),
      pays.nothing(),
    ),
  ],
});

<!-- Generated from the blueprint. Do not edit. -->
# handle.claim

Claim a free name and make it the address of your public page, with its profile.

**Who may call:** anyone signed in.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| name | handle.name | A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page. |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| handle | handle.id | The handle's own id. |

## Move

`claim`: from nothing (it creates) to claimed, emitting HandleClaimed.

## Steps

- `handle.claim.load` (database)
- `handle.claim.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| HandleTaken | 10 | HN-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| HandleAlreadyOwned | 12 | HN-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't anyone signed in; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### a name is claimed once

Starts from the world `claimed`.

- **the same request again answers the same handle and claims nothing.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends name `claimedname`, with the request key `first-claim`, and gets back the world's handle.
- **a taken name is refused.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends name `claimedname`, with the request key `bobs-claim`, and is refused with HandleTaken, HN-001.
- **another person's request key is not aaron's: still refused.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends name `claimedname`, with the request key `first-claim`, and is refused with HandleTaken, HN-001.
- **the refusal left bob free to claim a name of his own.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends name `bobspage`, and is answered.

### a stranger cannot edit a page

Starts from the world `page-to-guard`.

- **someone who is not signed in cannot claim a name.** `visitor` (anyone) calls and sends name `visitorpage`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.

### claim a handle

Starts from an empty world.

- **aaron claims the free name.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends name `firstpage`, and gets back an answer matching `^hdl_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **aaron cannot claim a second name while he holds one.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends name `secondpage`, and is refused with HandleAlreadyOwned, HN-002.

### release a handle

Starts from the world `claimed-to-release`.

- **someone else claims the released name.** `bob` (signed in) calls and sends name `releasepage`, and is answered.
- **aaron can claim again: a released handle does not count as one he holds.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends name `aaronspage`, and is answered.

### a person claims a page and shares it

Starts from an empty world.

- **aaron claims @aaron.** `aaron` (signed in) calls and sends name `aaron`, and gets back an answer matching `^hdl_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
linkup handle claim --name <name>
```

HTTP: `POST /handle/claim` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.handle.claim(payload)`.

# handle

A public name that belongs to one person until they release it, and is the address of a public page.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| id | id | The handle's own id. |
| name | HandleName | A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page. |
| owner | id | The person who holds the name. |

## Machine

States: claimed, released. A move from the wrong state is refused HandleNotClaimed (exit 11).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| claim | (creates) | claimed | HandleClaimed |
| release | claimed | released | HandleReleased |

## Events

- `HandleClaimed`: carries handle (handle.id: The handle's own id.), name (handle.name: A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page.); emitted by the move claim
- `HandleReleased`: carries handle (handle.id: The handle's own id.), name (handle.name: A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page.); emitted by the move release

## Unique

- name: unique while claimed
- owner: unique while claimed

## Roles

- handleOwner

## Operations

- [handle.claim](claim.md): Claim a free name and make it the address of your public page, with its profile.
- [handle.release](release.md): Free your name and take its public page offline. Anyone may claim the name afterwards.
- [handle.resolve](resolve.md): Find the handle that holds a claimed name. A released or unclaimed name has none.

// Journey-author file. The builders never edit it (AGENTS.md, "Journeys and checks come first").
// The one-sentence story of LinkUp at stage 1, through the SDK's calls. Its other halves (the person signs up; a fresh
// folder; the CLI, MCP and HTTP) cannot be written as journeys yet: see journeys/README.md, "The story".
import { Blueprint, emits, expect, noEvents, spans } from "orthograph";
import { HandleClaimed } from "../blueprint/things/handle/events.ts";
import { machine as handle } from "../blueprint/things/handle/machine.ts";
import claim from "../blueprint/things/handle/verbs/claim.ts";
import { LinkAdded } from "../blueprint/things/link/events.ts";
import add from "../blueprint/things/link/verbs/add.ts";
import get from "../blueprint/things/profile/verbs/get.ts";

export default Blueprint.journey("a person claims a page and shares it", {
  // Until M2 (sign-in), aaron is one of the world's fixed test people. The sign-up step is the story's first and cannot run yet.
  cast: { aaron: Blueprint.signedIn, visitor: Blueprint.anyone },
  steps: (s) => [
    s.step(
      "aaron claims @aaron",
      s.aaron.run(claim, { name: "aaron" }),
      expect((a) => a.handle).toMatch(/^hdl_[0-9a-z]+$/),
      emits(HandleClaimed, { handle: s.last.handle, name: "aaron" }),
      handle.isIn(s.last.handle, "claimed"),
      spans({ present: ["handle.claim", "handle.claim.load", "handle.claim.record", "handle.claim.commit"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron adds his GitHub",
      s.aaron.run(add, { title: "GitHub", url: "https://github.com/aaron" }),
      emits(LinkAdded, { link: s.last.link }),
      spans({ present: ["link.add.record", "link.add.commit"] }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron adds his blog",
      s.aaron.run(add, { title: "Blog", url: "https://aaron.example.com/blog" }),
      emits(LinkAdded, { link: s.last.link }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "aaron adds his talks",
      s.aaron.run(add, { title: "Talks", url: "https://aaron.example.com/talks" }),
      emits(LinkAdded, { link: s.last.link }),
    ),
    s.step(
      "anyone sees his public page at @aaron: three links in the order he added them",
      s.visitor.run(get, { handle: "aaron" }),
      expect((a) => a.handle).toBe("aaron"),
      expect((a) => a.links.map((l: { title: string; url: string }) => [l.title, l.url])).toEqual([
        ["GitHub", "https://github.com/aaron"],
        ["Blog", "https://aaron.example.com/blog"],
        ["Talks", "https://aaron.example.com/talks"],
      ]),
      noEvents(),
      spans({ present: ["profile.get", "profile.get.load"] }),
    ),
  ],
});
